name: Oraclip
tagline: AI motion control: put any move on your photo
description: Oraclip is an AI motion control and motion transfer video agent. Drop in one photo of a person, pet or product, add a reference clip or simply describe the move, and Oraclip picks the video model (Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 or MiniMax H3), writes the full prompt and renders the clip, up to 30 seconds, vertical or widescreen. It also animates still photos (image-to-video), ships ready-made templates for viral AI video trends such as the Babydoll dance, Hotel Lobby and Parking Lot dance, and keeps a library of motion transfer prompts with attribution to their creators. Credit costs are shown before every render, failed renders are refunded automatically, and paid plans include a commercial license.
